capabilities: generate the Publish runtime in publish.js and publish.css between markers
convert map and timeline data into publishable Markdown data notes
generate assets manifest notes linking all referenced files
render read-only interactive maps (pan, zoom, markers, overlays) on the Publish site
render timeline code blocks from pre-generated data notes on the Publish site
disambiguation: Not a TTRPG content or campaign tool itself; it only prepares Maps and Timeline output for Obsidian Publish.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that inline (storage: note) marker storage is not supported; JSON marker files are required. Roadmap mentions future tools and design options.
motivation: Kept separate from Maps and Timeline so non-Publish users avoid extra runtime, the main plugins stay smaller, and other tools can gain Publish support later.
problem: Obsidian Publish cannot render TTRPG Tools interactive maps or timeline code blocks without a generated runtime and pre-exported data notes.

relations.evidence: TTRPG Tools: Timeline (Simple Timeline) so timeline code blocks can be rendered
a helper plugin for people who publish their vault as a website (Obsidian Publish)

summary: Publish bridge that generates publish.js, publish.css and data notes so TTRPG Tools maps and timelines render on Obsidian Publish sites.
